svg.text: ALZ-lite builds the shared platform; vending connects each member
Shared services subscription placed under Platform
Separate approval step, not a Bicep step
Tenant administrator grants Graph read permissions to
the shared SQL MI directory identity
Peer spoke and existing datacenter to the hub
Apply member RBAC and workload budget
with an owner and an expiry
The pipeline deploys the foundation. Agents do not deploy ALZ-lite or vending.
